lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ዕግበት ፍቕራ ዘንቀሎ
ልበይ ይጐስዕ ኣሎ
መዝሙር ምስጋና ፣
በረኸት ስማ ዘሕደረሉ
ድንግል ማርያም ክብል ነቒሉ
[[/chorus]]

ኣደ መድኅነይ ክብል ዘወትር ወግሐ ጸብሐ
[[highlight]]ነናሻዕ እድሰት ጭንቀት ውሽጠይ ገኒሐ (2)[[/highlight]]
ካብ ልምዲ ‘ይኮነን’ኮ ዝደጋገም ብህሎ
[[highlight]]መንፈስ‘ዩ ቅኒቱ ከቶ የለን ዝብልሎ (2)[[/highlight]]

ኣብታ ጽምዋ ቤተይ ቀባሕባሕ ምንጋሡ
[[highlight]]ጽምዋስ ከም ሻሙ ናፍቖታ’ምበር ብኢሱ(2)[[/highlight]]
ግን ኵሉ ክርስዖ ድምጻ ምስ ሰማዕኩ
[[highlight]]ትዝ’ብለኒ ዅሉ ከምዛ ብተይ ‘ናዘለልኩ(2)[[/highlight]]

ዕቅብቲ መርዓት መጸት መርዓዊ ‘ኸቲላ
[[highlight]]ብደመና ሰማይ ክቡር ስሉም ሠረገላ(2)[[/highlight]]
ወላዲት ጸሓይ ‘ያ ‘ኮ ወርሒ’ዛ ድምቕቲ
[[highlight]]ዘምርላ ነፍሰይ ብዝማሬ መላእኽቲ(2)[[/highlight]]

ንዘይትመውት ነፍሰይ መን ኣለዋ ተስፋ
[[highlight]]ብዘይካ ዋሕሳ ዋሕስ መን ተደጊፋ(2)[[/highlight]]
ሥጋይ’ኳ እንተቕበጸት ከይሰምር ፍታዋ
[[highlight]]ነፍሰይ ኣሚናላ ካብ ጸልማት ክትሕልዋ(2)[[/highlight]]

ትጽቢት ርህርህቲ ጽዮን ቅድስቲ ከተማ
[[highlight]]ሃንቀውታኣ ’ንድዩ ንኽብሕቶ ሰላማ(2)[[/highlight]]
ወሲነ ኣለኹ ኣነስ ከይጥምት ንድሕረይ
[[highlight]]ስም ወዳ ከመስግን ፈልፋሊ‘ዩ መዝሙረይ(2)[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
ʿIgbet fiqhra zenqelo
Libey yigosʿi ʾalo
Mezmur misgana ,
Berekhet sima zehderelu
Dingil Maryam kibl neqhilu
[[/chorus]]

ʾAde medhiney kibl zewetr wegha tsebha
[[highlight]]Nenashaʿi ʾidset ch'inqet wisht'ey geniha (2)[[/highlight]]
Kab limdi ‘yikonen’ko zidegagem bihlo
[[highlight]]Menfes‘yu qinitu keto yelen ziblilo (2)[[/highlight]]

ʾAbta tsimwa betey qebahbah mingasu
[[highlight]]Tsimwas kem shamu nafqhota’miber biʾisu(2)[[/highlight]]
Gin kulu kirsiʿo dimtsa mis semaʿiku
[[highlight]]Tiz’bileni khulu kemza bitey ‘nazelelku(2)[[/highlight]]

ʿIqbiti merʿat metset merʿawi ‘khetila
[[highlight]]Bidemena semay kibur silum seregela(2)[[/highlight]]
Weladit tsehay ‘ya ‘ko werhi’za dimqhiti
[[highlight]]Zemrila nefsey bizmare melaʾikhti(2)[[/highlight]]

Nizeytimewt nefsey men ʾalewa tesfa
[[highlight]]Bizeyka wahsa wahs men tedegifa(2)[[/highlight]]
Sigay’kwa ʾinteqhbetset keysemr fitawa
[[highlight]]Nefsey ʾaminala kab tselmat kithilwa(2)[[/highlight]]

Titsbit rihrihti Tsiyon qidsiti ketema
[[highlight]]Hanqewtaʾa ’nidyu nikhbihto selama(2)[[/highlight]]
Wesine ʾalekhu ʾanes keyt'imt nidhirey
[[highlight]]Sim weda kemesgin felfali‘yu mezmurey(2)[[/highlight]]
